svg.title: TTA Notifications v0.6 — Heartbeats, missed heartbeat, event-number gap recovery ($events / $status)

g.text: TTA Notifications v0.6 — Heartbeats, missed heartbeat, event-number gap recovery ($events / $status)
[every heartbeat period, when nothing else was sent]
a client that ignores heartbeats still
no notification for > 1.5 x heartbeat period
log N and server status; adopt server status
(POC gap: N is logged but not yet used to
trigger $events recovery from a heartbeat miss —
only an arriving event triggers gap recovery)
permutation 4: client requested a heartbeat the
server does not honour -> this loop fires forever,
event 2 allocated but delivery fails / is lost
reply shape) inherited via v0.6's conformance clause;
v0.6 restates it loosely rather than referencing it [SPEC, editorial]
empty mode ends here by construction:
[SPEC] the spec never says duplicates get 200;
a 422 here would cause retry storms
— in order, deduplicated, one uniform shape
